v2.5.9 Update
⚗️ PF2e physical item quantities: Stat Tracking now covers every PF2e physical item type, keeps zero-quantity items selectable, and supports resources such as Versatile Vial.

announcement.title: ⚔️ Stylish Action HUD v2.5.9
announcement.content:
PF2e physical item quantity tracking now covers every physical item type.

  • The path picker lists all PF2e physical item types, including ammunition, armor, backpacks, books, shields, and weapons.
  • Items at zero quantity remain selectable, and quantity editing uses the same physical-item check.
  • Resources such as Versatile Vial can now be tracked directly from the HUD.
